description: Angular component for an entity alias dialog in the Thingsboard UI, managing alias creation and editing with form validation and service integration.

classes.name: EntityAliasDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular component for creating/editing entity aliases with form validation and dialog control.

methods.name: validateDuplicateAliasName
methods.description: Validator function to check for duplicate alias names among existing entity aliases.

methods.name: isErrorState
methods.description: Determines if the form control is in an error state for UI validation feedback.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without saving changes.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Calls the entity service to resolve the alias filter asynchronously.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates form data, updates alias object, and submits it if valid.
